title: Obtaining Alternative Cloud Domain Details Using API

blocks.text: This article provides information for getting alternative cloud domain details using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see Understanding Rate Limiting.
To get all alternative cloud domain details for the Zscaler cloud, send a GET request to the following endpoint in the Zscaler Path Cloud Controller: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/zpathCloud/getAltClouds.
